result.title: TreeHCA: Hindsight-Guided Exploration and Credit Assignment for Multi-Turn LLM Agents
result.summary: Outcome-supervised group-relative policy optimization (GRPO) assigns the same advantage to every token in an LLM agent trajectory, leaving useful and unhelpful decisions undifferentiated. Hindsight credit assignment (HCA) can refine this feedback, but its estimates rely on trajectories containing informative alternatives at consequential histories. We introduce TreeHCA, which couples hindsight-guided exploration with hindsight credit assignment. TreeHCA uses changes in reference-answer likelihood to revisit intermediate histories and sample alternative continuations, forming a tree of reasoning and tool interactions. Because this exploration changes the distribution of sampled continuations, we derive the corresponding inverse-hindsight importance correction, including an exact finite-pool identity. We use this structure in a normalized tree backup that propagates terminal outcomes into turn-level advantages. This shared hindsight structure is TreeHCA's central design principle, linking informative exploration with hindsight-guided credit assignment. Across seven question-answering benchmarks and three Qwen backbones, TreeHCA outperforms all baselines in aggregate exact match, validating the effectiveness of paired exploration and credit assignment for multi-turn LLM agent training. Our code is available at github.com/TheBlackCat22/TreeHCA.

AI.brief_summary: TreeHCA 针对多轮 LLM agent 训练中 GRPO 对整条轨迹均匀分配优势的问题，将 hindsight 引导的探索与 hindsight 信用分配耦合：利用参考答案似然变化回访中间历史、采样替代续写形成推理与工具交互树，并推导相应的 inverse-hindsight 重要性修正与归一化树回传，把终局结果传播为 turn 级优势，在七个问答基准和三个 Qwen 主干上取得最优聚合 exact match。
AI.relevance_reason: 其把终局反馈回传为中间步骤（turn 级）优势的做法，可能为 latent 视觉推理中多步推理状态的贡献分配与轨迹监督提供方法借鉴，待核查这套树式 hindsight 信用分配能否迁移到含视觉证据筛选的推理轨迹。
